title: Style / rangeslider: Problems with the alignements
body:
![screen shot 2017-10-04 at 12 24 47](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/393765/31171411-e287db6e-a8ff-11e7-85c4-a4e18f3dca17.png)

I think the handles should not go beyond the verticals defined by the headers. Same goes for the labels.

comments.body: This is trickier than expected. Maybe we should rethink with good default when we move on with instantsearch.css? cc @ronanlevesque
Sorry for the late reply. Yes, this is tricky, not sure this can be done without JS.
@ronanlevesque no worries. I think we want to know what it should look like visually and then we'll fix everything that need to be fixed. WDYT?
I wonder if some padding to the inner part could not fix it?

@bobylito agreed.

@Haroenv not really, because we want the tooltip/value to be horizontally centered to its handle/marker except when you get close to the edge. But if we add internal padding, it will have an impact on other slider elements as well.
Closing since the styles now depend on [InstantSearch.css](https://yarnpkg.com/en/package/instantsearch.css).
